text: Trigonometry formulae: In any right-angled triangle ABC where a, b and c are the length of the sides and c is the hypotenuse: sin A = a/c, cos A = b/c, tan A = a/b. In any triangle ABC where a, b and c are the length of the sides: sine rule: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C; cosine rule: a² = b² + c² − 2bc cos A; Area = ½ab sin C
